blocks.text: Newlyweds EA Guzman and Shaira Diaz are bringing their real-life romance to the big screen as they star in the upcoming family feature film “Buddy,“ marking their first movie project together as husband and wife. Shot entirely against the scenic landscapes of Finland, the movie is produced by MAVX Productions and directed by Lucky Blanco. The film brings together the couple’s personal dynamics and professional artistry for the first time since their wedding.
